newsitem.title: NORWAY: BP makes North Sea hydrocarbons discovery.
newsitem.headline: BP makes North Sea hydrocarbons discovery.

text.p: British Petroleum Norge has found hydrocarbons in block 2/1 in the North Sea, south of the Gyda oilfield, the Norwegian Oil Directorate (OD) said on Wednesday.
The OD said it was too early to estimate the size of the discovery.
Exploration well 2/1-11, drilled to a depth of 4,702 metres below sea level, was later suspended for further evaluation, it said.

BP is operator of licence 019B with a 26.625 percent stake and is partnered by Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 50 percent, Norske Conoco with 9.375 percent, Norske AEDC and Norske MOECO with five percent each and Pelican A/S with four percent.
